subject: Crestpoint SIG intake — scheduling, dataflow diagram, and log samples
messages:
From: Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@crestpoint.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG intake and two quick questions before scheduling

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for coordinating. Our security team wants to do a SIG/CAIQ intake next week. Before we pin a slot, two quick items so we can set expectations:

1) Can you share a current dataflow diagram (high level) that shows where customer data, logs, and model artifacts live? We're particularly interested in network boundaries (VPCs), any third-party logging sinks, and where KV caches are held.

2) Do you have a sample (redacted) JSON log snippet that shows request/response metadata we can use for our retention and SIEM mapping? A 3–5 line example will do.

If we get those, we'll send a short prep packet and pick a 60-min slot.

Thanks,
Dana Ortiz
Sr. InfoSec Manager — Crestpoint Analytics
security@crestpoint.com

Attachment: crestpoint_seed_questions.xlsx (sent by our team; will attach once we confirm time)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@crestpoint.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake and two quick questions before scheduling

Hi Dana —

Great to meet you (virtually). Happy to run the SIG intake — thanks for the two asks. We can provide:

- A sanitized dataflow diagram that highlights VPC boundaries, ingress/egress, and where ephemeral KV caches live.
- A redacted log sample (JSON) that includes request metadata, token counts, and request IDs for mapping to SIEM fields.

Proposed times (PST) for a 60-min intake call:
- Tue 2026-12-08, 10:00–11:00
- Wed 2026-12-09, 09:00–10:00
- Wed 2026-12-09, 14:00–15:00

Olga (security eng) and David (platform ops) are on copy and will bring the artifacts. Can you confirm a preferred time and whether recording the session is OK? We'll upload the pre-call packet to a shared Drive link and drop it in the follow-up.

Action items for us before the call:
- Olga: prepare redacted log sample + retention excerpt
- David: prepare network/dataflow PDF + third-party list

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: SIG intake and two quick questions before scheduling

Marcus / David —

Quick internal sync: I'm assembling the sample logs and will redact PII and token-level content. Plan:
- log_sample_redwood_redacted.json (10–12 lines, shows request_id, timestamp, route, model_name, tokens_in/tokens_out)
- retention_excerpt.txt (excerpt of our retention policy, call out logs kept for 90 days by default, with options for longer retention under Dedicated/Private)

David, will need the latest network diagram (public/private subnets, any NAT gateways, and where we push to long-term archival buckets). I will also annotate where caching occurs so they understand ephemeral storage.

I'll upload artifacts to a pre-call folder and mark owners. Estimated upload by Fri 2026-12-04 EOD.

Olga
Sr. Infosec Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@crestpoint.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Crestpoint SOC Team <security@crestpoint.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 11:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake and two quick questions before scheduling

Thanks — Wed 2026-12-09 09:00–10:00 PST works for our team. Recording is fine.

I've attached our initial seed questions (crestpoint_seed_questions.xlsx) — it includes a short list of items we want to cover and a checkbox for whether we need follow-up evidence. For the call please have someone who can speak to:
- Network boundaries and peering options (VPC vs. Private deployment)
- Log formats and retention controls
- Data residency and encryption in transit at rest

We'll aim to limit the meeting to 60 minutes. Please send the pre-call packet link when available.

Dana

Attachment: crestpoint_seed_questions.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Dana Ortiz <dana.ortiz@crestpoint.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Post-call notes: Crestpoint SIG intake (2026-12-09) — actions and artifacts

Dana / Crestpoint team —

Thanks for the helpful conversation yesterday. Summary and agreed next steps below. Recording link and artifacts are attached.

Meeting summary (high level):
- We walked through Redwood's hosted and private deployment dataflows, highlighting where request metadata, caches, and logs live.
- Discussed default log retention (90 days) and options for custom retention in Dedicated/Private plans.
- Clarified encryption in transit and at rest; KMS integration options for Private deployments.

Agreed action items (owners):
- Olga Petrov: upload redacted log sample and retention excerpt to shared Drive (done) — file: log_sample_redwood_redacted.json
- David Kim: publish updated network/dataflow diagram (redwood_dataflow_v1.pdf) and a short third-party catalog (S3 archival, Datadog) — file: redwood_dataflow_v1.pdf
- Marcus Lin: create Jira ticket to track evidence requests and next deliverables: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-482 (assigned to Marcus)

Attachments uploaded to shared folder: redwood_dataflow_v1.pdf, log_sample_redwood_redacted.json, retention_excerpt.txt, sig-call-recording-2026-12-09.mp4

If you need specific RFC-like artifacts (e.g., sample IAM policies, audit log export runbook), call them out in SEC-482 and we'll queue them for delivery.

Thanks again — happy to jump on a follow-up deep-dive if you want to map SIEM fields to our logs.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
